name: Henry James Meier Jr.

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Mary M. Proudlove, 22, of Forty Fort, daughter of Oliver Proudlove (blacksmith, born England) and Anna [Lane?] (born New Jersey). Luzerne docket No. 79542. He was 22, a moulder, of Wilkes-Barre. His parents are given as Henry J. (moulder) and Anna Higgins.

bioAdditions: The 1957 Pennsylvania death index lists 'MEIER HARRY J, 62, WLKS BRE, county 40, died 01/29/57, file 5614' (S1). This confirms the FamilySearch date of 29 Jan 1957. The tree had only the year. FamilySearch also gives burial at St Mary's Cemetery, Hanover Twp, on 1 Feb 1957 (S3). His marriage docket (No. 79542, June 1917) shows him as a 22-year-old moulder like his father. He married Mary M. Proudlove of Forty Fort, whose father was an English-born blacksmith (S2). On this docket his father's birthplace is written 'Penna', which contradicts the German birth recorded elsewhere. Their children were Robert J. (1918–98), Marjorie (1920–2010, Mrs. Harold Stitzer), Harry J. Jr. (1924–95) and Regina (1926–2012, Mrs. Francis Gimber) (S3).

conflicts.note: Probably an error by the clerk. Madeline's 1936 licence says Germany.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: The state death index matches his name, age, town and date.
